description: Required completion gate: action=workflow stays ready=false until a current runtime capture passes all artistic criteria. After screen_assets/assembly, submit screen_item (or design/project), renderer_version, capture_item, capture and the authorized review_budget; workflow schedules the reviewer automatically. Poll workflow; correct and recapture if changes_requested. No paid retry loop. Genre-independent workflow: pass design (from plan, edited) WITHOUT project to get/quote/concept/review_quote/review. get returns the normalized design hash; quote then concept returns reference_item. For review supply design, reference_item, renderer_version (fingerprint of actual presenter/build including styles/assets/dependencies), capture_item and capture. Forward exact quote.next and poll the generation job. This reviews an immutable snapshot; compare returned identity with current files before reusing the result. No installed kit or per-genre adapter is needed for concept/review. Project mode remains available: Artistic QA: get returns renderer_version and latest review. Upload a fresh HUD viewport screenshot to the private Library, call review_quote with capture_item/capture, forward exact next to review and poll its job. Re-read get: only current approved review validates that capture/state; preview cannot validate game contrast. Reusable HUD design: action templates/plan/get/apply/quote/concept uses HUD Studio v2 + hud.tactical + ui.theme; concept is a durable per-game AI reference. FPS live adapter on Bevy web; other genres can export templates. Omit action for legacy. Survivor HUD kit: hud.json + cartoon PNGs + Godot .tscn + Three / Unity / Unreal snippets. Writes the folder (npm). 1 credit. Do not redraw the hearts.

action.description: v2 reusable design workflow; omit to keep the survivor v1 export.

brief.description: Preserve user visual references verbatim, then describe typography, shapes, density and hierarchy independently of the world setting. quote returns the exact concept_prompt for inspection.

capture.description: Use hashes from get, dimensions in CSS pixels, actual dpr/scale and captured game state. Caller-submitted evidence, not server attestation.

capture_item.description: Owned private Library image containing only the actual HUD viewport, not the concept. Required for review_quote/review.

design.description: Full design returned by plan, with edited document/theme/brief. Without project: standalone get, concept and artistic review for any genre. With project: apply only.

expected_revision.description: Required for project apply/concept/review; omitted in document mode. Forward quote.next.

health_style.description: hearts skin or bar skin, or custom:<slug> from gripforge_hud_bar

quote_hash.description: Required for review and document-mode concept; forward the exact next payload from the quote.

reference_item.description: Document-mode review: chosen concept Library ID. No project link required; use concept result.reference_item or an existing reference.

reference_region.description: Normalized 0..1 crop of the concept gameplay panel; exclude menu studies. Defaults to full image.

renderer_version.description: Document mode: fingerprint of the actual HUD presenter/build including styles, fonts/assets and dependencies. Must match capture.renderer_version; declared by caller, not inferred from genre.

review_budget.description: workflow: authorized cap for one review in the quoted currency. With a capture, schedules the existing reviewer automatically within this cap; repeated calls reuse the job.

screen_item.description: Analysed/cut screen Library ID. Uses its original concept and stored layout; omit design, project and reference_item. get/workflow/review_quote/review.

template.description: tactical, rpg, survivor, kart, royale, moba; see templates.

name: gripforge_hud
